read_language_file: read an ASE language file and parse scene commands with entity parameters into a list of tuples
read_trajectory_file: read a ground truth trajectory CSV file and return device poses with positions, rotations, and transforms
read_points_file: read a gzip-compressed semidense point cloud CSV file and return world coordinates as a numpy array
transform_from_Rt: build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from a rotation matrix and translation vector
read_trajectory_line: parse a single ground truth trajectory CSV line into a pose dictionary with position, rotation, and transform
